title: 第15章 谁是废物第16章 滚吧
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;“金色气血！轮海境一重？他能够修炼了？”
“不可能，荒古圣体早就被天地法则抛弃，降下十道枷锁，束缚其成长。”
“难不成是紫薇圣主出手，帮他解开了一道枷锁？”
辰南的气息一出，所有人都目瞪口呆。
谁也没有想到，拥有废体的辰南不仅能够修炼，而且还突破到了轮海境一重。
这……这简直是不可思议！
“这怎么可能？”
萧天麟大吃一惊。
“他果然能够修炼！”
林轻眉咬牙切齿。
她和辰南相处了三年，从没见过辰南修炼，更没有表现出任何的战斗力，就是一个武道废柴。
但他不仅能够击败林子衿，更突破了轮海境。
这实在让她难以置信。
“他肯定一直在偷偷修炼，故意欺骗我！”
林轻眉认为自己被欺骗了，否则短短十天，辰南怎么可能会有这么大的提升。
此时所有人都认为是紫薇圣主出手，帮辰南解开了一道枷锁，所以他才能修炼。
但只有姜玉婵知道，紫薇圣主根本没有出过手。
不过她也没有拆穿，而是心中稍稍松了口气。
她可不想见到辰南落败受辱。
如今辰南拥有实力，便有了获胜的资本。
这一战谁胜谁负，还犹未可知。
“萧天麟，为了公平起见，由老夫来封印你的修为！”
药长老一步踏出，主动请缨。
他是圣人境强者，而且与辰南关系莫逆，由他出手，便不怕萧天麟耍花招。
萧天麟虽然吃惊辰南的境界，但此时赌约已成，他骑虎难下，不得不硬着头皮迎战。
很快，药长老亲自出手，封印了萧天麟的修为。
如此一来，辰南与萧天麟都是轮海境一重，公平公正。
“辰南，就算同阶一战，我也能将你踩在脚下！”
萧天麟咬牙切齿，恨意难消。
唰！

read2(); "Golden Qi and blood! First level of Wheel Sea Realm? Can he practice?"
"Impossible, the Ancient Holy Body has long been abandoned by the laws of heaven and earth, and ten shackles have been placed on it to restrict its growth."
"Could it be that Holy Lord Ziwei took action and helped him untie a shackles?"
As soon as Chen Nan's breath came out, everyone was stunned.
No one thought that Chen Nan, who had a waste body, could not only practice, but also break through to the first level of the Wheel Sea Realm.
This...this is simply incredible!
"How is this possible?"
Xiao Tianlin was shocked.
"He can indeed practice!"
Lin Qingmei gritted her teeth.
She had been with Chen Nan for three years, but she had never seen Chen Nan practice, let alone show any fighting ability. He was just a martial arts loser.
But not only was he able to defeat Lin Zijin, he also broke through the Lun Hai realm.
This was beyond belief.
"He must have been practicing secretly and deliberately deceiving me!"
Lin Qingmei thought she had been deceived, otherwise how could Chen Nan have made such a big improvement in just ten days.
At this time, everyone thought that Holy Master Ziwei took action and helped Chen Nan unlock a shackles, so that he could practice.
But only Jiang Yuchan knew that Holy Lord Ziwei had never taken any action.
But she didn't expose it, but felt a little relieved.
She didn't want to see Chen Nan defeated and humiliated.
Now that Chen Nan has the strength, he has the capital to win.
It is still unclear who will win and who will lose in this battle.
"Xiao Tianlin, for the sake of fairness, I will seal your cultivation!"
Elder Yao stepped forward and took the initiative to ask for help.
He is a strong man in the saint realm, and he has an irreversible relationship with Chen Nan. If he takes action, he will not be afraid of Xiao Tianlin's tricks.
Although Xiao Tianlin was surprised by Chen Nan's level, the bet was now fulfilled. He was unable to get off the tiger and had to bite the bullet and fight.
Soon, Elder Yao took action himself and sealed Xiao Tianlin's cultivation.
In this way, Chen Nan and Xiao Tianlin are both at the first level of the Wheel Sea Realm, fair and just.
"Chen Nan, even if we fight at the same level, I can still trample you under my feet!"
Xiao Tianlin gritted his teeth, his hatred hard to go away.
Uh-huh!
